meta.name: skillsguard
meta.description: Audit AI agent skill packages for security threats before installing or using them. Use this skill to scan a SKILL.md file or skill directory for prompt injection, exfiltration, command injection, persistence, privilege escalation, obfuscation, supply-chain attacks, and model-specific jailbreak patterns. Triggers: 'scan skill', 'audit skill', 'skillsguard', 'check this skill', 'is this skill safe', 'skill security', 'skill audit', 'review skill', 'scan all skills', 'audit my skills folder'.
